posts.body_html: Here's a really nice red clone from Okaloosa Co, FL. Normally, the red variants only color up during the fall when we have sunny days and cool nights, but this one is pretty dang red in the middle of summer! Pics taken 7/26/21:
posts.body_text: Here's a really nice red clone from Okaloosa Co, FL.  Normally, the red variants only color up during the fall when we have sunny days and cool nights, but this one is pretty dang red in the middle of summer!  Pics taken 7/26/21:

posts.body_html:
Looks like almost every single clone colored up this year, pretty cool! That said, there are some genetically red variants that color up easier than the rest. Check out the diversity in this population! Pics taken 9/9/21:









Lots of new traps still in the process of developing:




green face! reminds me of some minor giant clones:


very few veins on the body, peachy color:
